team_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Conditional team bonus damage from passive proc. Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).

en.flavor: A statue carved in the shape of an eagle, a sacred relic of the Masters of the Night-Wind that has been passed down from generation to generation.

refinements.1: Increases Elemental Mastery by <r>100</r>. Gain the "Mirror of Night" effect within 15s after the equipping character creates a shield: The current active party member deals <r>28%</r> increased DMG to nearby opponents. You can gain the "Mirror of Night" effect once every 14s.

fr.flavor: Une statue sculptée en forme d'aigle. C'est une relique sacrée transmise par les Maîtres du vent nocturne.

passive.name: Offrande au vent et au soleil

refinements.1: La maîtrise élémentaire augmente de <r>100</r> pts et le personnage équipé de l'arme obtient l'effet Miroir nocturne pendant 15 s après avoir créé un bouclier : les DGT infligés par votre personnage déployé aux ennemis proches augmentent de <r>28 %</r>.
